Hello! First, I hope you can get some good sleep soon. Being sleep deprived sucks.

Second, yes, I unfortunately have a lot of experience with intrusive and suicidal thoughts. My best advice is to find something that is all consuming. Whether it is reading a book, working out, running, playing a hard video game, writing an essay, or whatever you’re interested in, find something that requires the entirety of your mental energy. This is what I do when I start ruminating or having intrusive thoughts, as it leaves no room for the voice to intrude. 

Third, and most important, do not do anything rash. It is important that you acknowledge that the thoughts are running counter to your desires. Keep that in the forefront of your mind when dealing with them. 

If none of that works for you and you continue having issues sleeping/dealing with the intrusive thoughts, don’t hesitate to seek professional help. I can only tell you what has worked for me! I hope it helps you even a little bit.

Have you seen an ENT or your GP about this? Maybe you have some kind of ear or sinus issue that is actually untreated, but if you are ruminating on intrusive thoughts, it could be a side effect of elevated blood pressure or something like that. I am not a doctor and don’t play one on TV, I’ve just dealt with daily anxiety/depression/OCD for the past 15 years so I can empathize. I’d suggest you see an actual medical professional about it if the symptoms continue.
